qs2027-144.history: Western was established in London, Ontario in 1878 and welcomed its first students in 1881. It purchased the site of its present campus in 1916 and adopted the University of Western Ontario name in 1923.

qs2027-201.history: Ohio State began in 1870 as the Ohio Agricultural and Mechanical College. Teaching started in 1873; the institution took its present university name in 1878.

qs2027-211.history: UAB was created by decree in June 1968. Its first four faculties covered humanities, medicine, science and economics, and teaching began that October.

qs2027-213.history: Hamad Bin Khalifa University was founded in 2010 within Qatar Foundation's education and research ecosystem. Its development centres on graduate education and research connected to Qatar and the wider region.

qs2027-226.history: The university was created in 1968 during Spain's expansion of public higher education. Its first classes used several sites in Madrid; the Cantoblanco campus opened in 1971.

qs2027-239.history: CEU developed in the early 1990s as an English-language postgraduate education and research project. Its early institutional history included colleges in Prague and Budapest, described in the university's 1993-94 academic publication.

qs2027-244.history: The University of Newcastle in Australia was established in 1965. Its own historical student guide records this foundation date; it is distinct from Newcastle University in the United Kingdom.

qs2027-246.history: Paris 1's modern multidisciplinary project dates from 1971. It combines humanities and social sciences with a historical connection to the medieval Sorbonne tradition, rather than treating the medieval college as the same modern institution.

qs2027-266.history: SUTD was established in 2009 with a curriculum built around design and interdisciplinary engineering. Its early development involved collaboration with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
qs2027-266.expected_name: Singapore University of Technology and Design

qs2027-268.history: Thomas Jefferson founded the University of Virginia in 1819. Its establishment was authorised through Virginia legislation in January of that year.

qs2027-272.history: Taylor's traces its educational heritage to Taylor's College, founded in 1969. The university's later development includes the Lakeside Campus; the college's foundation date describes the predecessor, not an assertion that university status began in 1969.

qs2027-276.history: Universitas Airlangga was inaugurated in Surabaya on 10 November 1954 by President Sukarno. Its roots include the city's earlier medical and dental education institutions.

qs2027-281.history: Pitt began in 1787 as the Pittsburgh Academy. Its institutional history developed from that early academy into a university associated with medical research, including work on the polio vaccine.

qs2027-351.history: The university began in Almaty in 1934 as the Kazakh Mining and Metallurgical Institute. It was named after geologist Kanysh Satbayev in 1999, linking its identity to Kazakhstan's technical education and earth sciences.

qs2027-356.history: Sunway's educational origins include Sunway College, established in Malaysia in 1987 by Jeffrey Cheah. This predecessor became part of the wider Sunway education ecosystem; the college's date is distinguished from the later university identity.

qs2027-359.history: The Peoples' Friendship University was founded in 1960 and named after Patrice Lumumba in 1961. In 1992 it adopted the Russian Peoples' Friendship University name.

qs2027-360.history: Indiana University Bloomington's historical timeline records the establishment of its law school in 1842 and its School of Education in 1908. The university's business school followed in 1920.

qs2027-391.history: Saint Petersburg State University traces its history to 1724. The university's publishing service describes academic publishing as an activity present since its early years, with university teaching announcements appearing in 1824.

qs2027-397.history: Ajman University was established in 1988. Its institutional history highlights early private higher education in the Gulf and the admission of expatriate students of both genders in the UAE.

qs2027-424.history: HSE was officially established in November 1992, initially offering master's programmes. It opened a campus in Nizhny Novgorod in 1996, followed by campuses in Saint Petersburg and Perm in 1997.

qs2027-454.history: The university's institutional timeline includes the creation of the Foundation for Life Sciences and Business Management in 2004, an early organisational step in the development of the Shoolini education project.
qs2027-454.expected_name: Shoolini University of Biotechnology and Management Sciences

qs2027-476.history: The national university was founded in 1905 through the initiative of Joaquin Victor Gonzalez. Its early project aimed to establish a modern university in La Plata.

qs2027-282.history: UCSI's predecessor began in 1986 as the Canadian Institute of Computer Science. It later became Sedaya College, gained university-college status in 2003 and full university status in 2008.

qs2027-287.history: ITB was established as its present institution in March 1959. Its Bandung campus had already hosted engineering education since the Technische Hogeschool opened in 1920.

qs2027-299.history: Legislation establishing UNIST was enacted in 2007. The university welcomed its first undergraduate cohort in 2009 as part of the development of science and engineering education in Ulsan.
qs2027-299.expected_name: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST)

qs2027-317.history: SUSTech developed in Shenzhen through institutional and campus construction decisions in 2010. Its first undergraduate students enrolled in 2011. It is distinct from Chongqing University of Science and Technology.
qs2027-317.expected_name: Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech)

qs2027-318.history: The institution traces its technical-education history to 1830. Its library was founded in the same year, supporting the early development of craft and technology teaching in Moscow.

qs2027-344.history: The University of Rome Tor Vergata was founded in 1982. A project for its botanical garden followed in 1985, forming part of the development of its new campus.

qs2027-348.history: Abu Dhabi University was established in 2003. It subsequently developed provision across several campuses in the UAE, including Abu Dhabi, Al Ain and Dubai.

qs2027-353.history: Brunel received its Royal Charter and university status in 1966. Its predecessor institutions included Acton Technical College, founded in 1928, and the later Brunel colleges of technology.

qs2027-355.history: Sciences Po dates its founding to 1872. The institution marked its 150th anniversary in 2022 with a programme of historical publications and events.

qs2027-361.history: UCAS traces its beginnings to a graduate school established in 1978. It adopted the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences name in 2012 and began enrolling undergraduate students in 2014.
qs2027-361.expected_name: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)

qs2027-362.history: The University of Oulu was founded in 1958. It developed as a multidisciplinary science university in northern Finland.

qs2027-363.history: City St George's was formed on 1 August 2024 through the merger of City, University of London and St George's, University of London. The merger preserved important elements of City's Royal Charter, first granted in 1966.
qs2027-363.expected_name: City St George’s, University of London

qs2027-365.history: Universidad Politecnica de Madrid was founded in 1971. Its institutional information records the development of a technical university offering engineering, research and postgraduate education.

qs2027-368.history: The University of Rio de Janeiro was established by federal decree in September 1920, bringing together earlier professional schools. It was reorganised as the University of Brazil in 1937, an important stage in the history of the present UFRJ.
qs2027-368.expected_name: Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro

qs2027-370.history: The modern University of Tehran was founded in 1934. Its historic campus is described in the Iranian submission held by the UNESCO World Heritage Centre.

qs2027-379.history: GIST was established by the Korean government in 1993 as a research-oriented graduate institution. Preparatory work began earlier, with a founding committee formed in 1991.
qs2027-379.expected_name: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST)

qs2027-380.history: Taiwan Tech began in 1974 as the National Taiwan Institute of Technology. It gained university status and its present name in 1997, after adding graduate programmes in earlier decades.
qs2027-380.expected_name: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (Taiwan Tech)

qs2027-385.history: DGIST was established in 2004 as a national science and technology institution in Daegu. Its development combines basic research with applied technology and graduate education.
qs2027-385.expected_name: Daegu Gyeongbuk Institute of Science and Technology (DGIST)

qs2027-386.history: Northeastern's origins lie in the educational activities of the Boston YMCA. The opening of its law teaching in October 1898 marks the beginning of the university's institutional history.

qs2027-395.history: Javeriana distinguishes its colonial period, from 1623 to 1767, from its modern period. University studies were reopened in 1930 after the earlier interruption associated with the expulsion of the Jesuits.

qs2027-407.history: INTI traces its beginnings to 1986. Its later expansion included a move to Subang Jaya and international partnerships; INTI College Malaysia received university-college status in 2006.

qs2027-408.history: The Hong Kong Institute of Education was formed in 1994 by merging four colleges and one institute. This predecessor existed under that name until 2016, within a teacher-education tradition extending further back.
qs2027-408.expected_name: The Education University of Hong Kong

qs2027-413.history: Singapore Management University was established in 2000. Its educational project developed a broad-based approach at the intersection of management, social sciences and technology.

qs2027-422.history: Prince Mohammad Bin Fahd University began operations in 2006 after approval of its establishment and charter. Its educational project includes research and service to the surrounding community.

qs2027-447.history: The university was created under a 1997 law of Castile and Leon. Instituto de Empresa took over its direction in 2006, a distinct milestone from the older business-school history.

qs2027-461.history: TIIAME connects its origins to hydraulic-engineering education at Turkestan State University in 1923. The separate institute was established in November 1934 with hydromelioration and mechanisation faculties.
qs2027-461.expected_name: Tashkent Institute of Irrigation and Agricultural Mechanization Engineers - National Research University (TIIAME-NRU)

qs2027-469.history: Kazan University was founded in 1804. Its early growth included a Pedagogical Institute opened in 1812 to train teachers for several regions of the Russian Empire.

qs2027-477.history: Ramon Llull University was created in March 1990 and approved by the Parliament of Catalonia in May 1991. Its founding institutions had earlier histories, including IQS, Blanquerna and La Salle.

qs2027-483.history: The national colleges of education, medicine and agriculture in Daegu developed during the post-war period. In 1951 these and other colleges combined to form Kyungpook National University.

qs2027-485.history: Jinan Academy, the predecessor of Jinan University, was founded in Nanjing in 1906. The institution moved to Shanghai in 1923 and adopted the National Jinan University name in 1927.

qs2027-491.history: Novosibirsk State University opened in September 1959. Academician Sergei Sobolev delivered its first lecture on contemporary mathematical problems to students across specialties.

qs2027-492.history: Prince Sultan College was established in 1998 and welcomed students in 1999. In 2003 it was elevated to university status as Prince Sultan University.

qs2027-496.history: Universitas Padjadjaran was established in Bandung in 1957. Its founding government regulation took effect on 11 September that year and is preserved in the university archive.

qs2027-042.history: Yonsei traces its origins to Gwanghyewon, a hospital founded in 1885. The subsequent development of medical and educational institutions formed the foundations of the university's Yonhi and Severance traditions.

qs2027-109.history: Sungkyunkwan dates its educational heritage to the national institute founded in 1398. Its chronology also records the development of a modern three-year university in 1895.

qs2027-143.history: National Tsing Hua University traces its history to Tsing Hua Imperial College in Beijing in 1911. It was re-established in Hsinchu, Taiwan in 1956, later expanding beyond its initial emphasis on nuclear science and technology.

qs2027-172.history: The territorial legislature established the predecessor of Arizona State University as a normal school in 1885. Teaching began in Tempe in 1886 with an initial cohort of 33 students.

qs2027-191.history: NCKU began in 1931 as Tainan Technical College. It became Provincial Cheng Kung University in 1956 and gained its present national-university designation in 1971.

qs2027-388.history: Universita Cattolica del Sacro Cuore was formally inaugurated in Milan in December 1921. In 1932 its central campus moved into the former Sant'Ambrogio monastery, which remains part of its institutional identity.
